{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to be safe
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Step 1: Clean revenue — remove commas and convert to float
# Check first if there are any commas in the revenue strings
print("Revenue examples before cleaning:", data['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Step 2: Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Remove QA orders
data_clean = data[~qa_mask].copy()

# Step 3: Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
refunded_mask = data_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}")

# Remove refunded orders
data_clean = data_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Step 4: Verify data after cleaning
print(f"Final data shape after cleaning: {data_clean.shape}")
print(f"Channels: {data_clean['channel'].unique()}")
print(f"Customer segments: {data_clean['customer_segment'].unique()}")

# Check conversion rate by channel
conversion_by_channel = data_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(conversion_by_channel)

# Check average revenue by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = data_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()
print("\nAverage revenue by channel:")
print(avg_revenue_by_channel)

# Check customer segment distribution by channel
segment_by_channel = pd.crosstab(data_clean['channel'], data_clean['customer_segment'])
print("\nCustomer segment distribution by channel:")
print(segment_by_channel)

# Final check: is the channel assignment balanced across segments?
print("\nSegment distribution in email vs paid_search:")
print(segment_by_channel.div(segment_by_channel.sum(axis=0), axis=1))"}
